column1: # Expected differences between a290-ha-addon and r5-ha-addon, after scripts/parity/map.tsv.
# Read by scripts/parity_check.py; the decision behind it is ADR 0001 (docs/adr/ in a290).
# Columns, tab-separated: category, path, side, match, count, reason.
#   category  model    a genuine per-car difference (endpoint behaviour, renders, branding)
#             legacy   r5 keeps Topolino65's names where a290 does not. Decided 2026-09-26
#                      (ADR 0001): r5 moves to a290's descriptive names in one migration
#                      release, so these entries, and map.tsv's legacy rules, go with it
#             local    belongs to one repository by nature
#             noise    versions, release history, binaries: expected to differ for good
#             pending  drift or a port not yet made. The reason names a Target:, and the
#                      entry is deleted when that lands. This list is the port backlog.
#   path      glob on the a290-named path (`*` also crosses `/`)
#   side      a290 | r5 | both: whose lines the entry covers
#   match     *            every differing line of the file (and a changed binary)
#             only         the file exists on that side only
#             re:<regex>   differing lines matching the regex
#             hunk:<regex> every line of each changed block that has a line matching it
#             py:<a,b>     differing lines owned by these top-level Python symbols
#             mode         the file's mode differs (e.g. 100755 vs 100644), side both. Only this
#                          excuses a mode difference; `*` covers content, never modes
#   count     exactly how many differing items the entry covers. `*` = any number, allowed
#             only with match `*`, and printed as unguarded on every run.
# Each differing item goes to the FIRST entry that takes it, so the more specific entry comes
# first. The check fails on an item no entry takes, an entry that takes nothing (the
# difference is gone: delete it) and a count that is off by any amount (a new line joined an
# old excuse, or an item was partly fixed: look, then edit). Never raise a count without
# reading what the check printed under it.
# Audit ids (P-B1, H-D5, ...) refer to the 2026-09-26 parity baseline summarised in the RFC
# cited by ADR 0001. "RFC open difference" means the RFC's table of behaviours to decide.
